research.title: Intent Classification for Short Support Requests
bullets: Prepared labeled support requests by normalizing whitespace, removing duplicate messages, and checking intent labels against the supplied annotation guidelines.
Implemented a TF-IDF logistic regression baseline and inspected confusion matrices to document errors among closely related request categories.

research.title: Sentence Function Classification in Scientific Abstracts
bullets: Segmented scientific abstracts into sentences, reconciled label formatting, and maintained document-level splits to prevent overlap between training and evaluation data.
Implemented a word n-gram classification baseline using supplied sentence labels and summarized misclassifications between background, methods, and conclusion statements.

projects.title: Baseline Sentiment Classification of Product Reviews
bullets: Implemented a multinomial naive Bayes sentiment classifier with bag-of-words features, fitting vocabulary and preprocessing transformations only on training reviews.
Evaluated held-out predictions using precision, recall, and confusion matrices, then examined errors involving negation and mixed sentiment.
